units.source_text: 这句话使我有闲暇看了看柏木的脸。

en.t: Those words gave me time to look at Kashiwagi's face.

units.source_text: 他带着一种奇妙的神色坐在那里。

en.t: He sat there with a strangely curious expression on his face.

units.source_text: 他到底把视线从我身上移开了。

en.t: At last he turned his gaze away from me.

units.source_text: 行恶时的他做出的一副表情，似是自己意识不到的、从性格的核心拍出来的、最纯洁的。

en.t: The expression he wore when doing evil seemed to be something he himself was unaware of, drawn from the core of his nature, and utterly pure.
